BiblicalUsage: Huldah is the prophetess the king's men consult when the book of the law is found in the temple. She speaks plainly: the judgment written in the book will come, and Josiah will be gathered to his grave in peace because his heart was tender. Her name appears only in the account of that one errand, and the errand changes a kingdom.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Huldah shows that God speaks through whomever He chooses, and a prophetess's word can turn a king to his knees.
